raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
July 2024 – Till date (Independent Practice, India)
Role	: Independent Portfolio Manager & Trading Analyst Domain	: Trading Strategies & Portfolio Management
Client	: Select Individual Investors
Project Summary:
Engaged in independent trading practice and portfolio management for a small group of investors. Focused on applying advanced trading strategies, risk management techniques, and disciplined portfolio optimization to deliver consistent performance and practical insights.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Completed structured training programs in advanced trading, risk management, and market structure analysis.
2. Managed investment portfolios for individual investors, emphasizing asset allocation, risk-adjusted returns, and performance tracking.
3. Applied option payoff modeling, delta-neutral positioning, and tactical portfolio adjustments to optimize outcomes.
4. Conducted market research and implemented disciplined trading frameworks to enhance decision-making and portfolio resilience.
5. Provided regular updates and performance reviews to investors, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Dec 2023 – July 2024 (Luxoft, India)
Role	: Principal Consultant Domain	: Transaction Reporting Client	: Trafigura
Project Summary:
The purpose of the project is the delivery of transaction reports for EMIR, MiFiD, DDFA, FinFrag, and MAS reporting.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Understanding business requirements for transaction reporting of multiple jurisdictions and translating the same into user stories.
2. Preparing, maintaining, and prioritizing product backlog.
3. Act as liaison between technology and the business to clarify functional issues during the project lifecycle and track them to closure.
4. Establish and maintain effective relationships with core and extended project team members, stakeholders, peers, and business representatives including Legal, compliance, technical teams, Finance, regulatory teams, etc.
5. Providing estimates for delivery.
6. Imparting domain & tool related trainings to new team members.
7. Providing E2E project management.
Feb 2020 - March 2023 (Credit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank, Singapore)
Role	: Lead Business Analyst/PO
Domain	: Payments and Cash Management
Client	: Credit Agricole Corporate and Invesment Bank
Project Summary:
The purpose of the project is the delivery of SWIFT cross border payment processing, SEPA payments and billing engine. It requires in-depth understanding of cross border payment formats (Swift MT101, MT103, MT202, MT202COV, MT900/910, CAMT 052/053/054, etc) and SEPA payments (pain.001, pacs.008, pacs.009, etc). It also includes building the orchestration layer for liaising with the payment engine, virtual account management for account reconciliation, and host to host communication for direct integration with the banking downstream applications.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to understand business requirements.
2. Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, and provide optimized solutions proposal.
3. Maintain product backlog, and assign severity and priority to user stories based on business need.
4. Prepare BRD’s and FRD’s if required.
5. Document as-is and would-be state of project in the form of process flow diagram and activity diagram using Visio/Enterprise Architect tools.
6. Manage project risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies with other program streams to overcome challenges and propose mitigation plans.
7. Understand the proprietary XML format of GPP and mapping it to different downstream applications in the payment flow.
8. Assist the UAT team in the functional analysis of the reported issues.
May 2015 - Sept 2019 (Barclays Technology Center, India)
Role	: AVP - Lead Business Analyst
Domain	: Finance & Risk (Credit Risk, Market Risk and Liquidity Risk) Client	: Barclays Bank
Project Summary: Local Regulatory Reporting (Asia Pacific & UK)
The purpose of the project is the delivery of finance and risk regulatory reports, transaction reports to the local country specific regulators in Asia Pacific region. It also includes risk engine calculations for reporting related to Counterparty Credit risk, Market risk, Liquidity risk, Basel III implementation, IFRS 9 implementation, and exposure to methodologies like VaR, Expected shortfall, PE, EEPE, CVA, etc.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Understanding the new finance and risk regulatory requirements from the business and performing the impact analysis to the current architecture.
2. Requirements gathering and understanding the changes applicable to the various businesses for products like Equity, Fixed Income, FX, AML, Rates, Commodities, Structured credit products, Derivatives, loans & deposits, collateral management, profit & loss, etc.
3. Ensuring the regulatory transaction reporting regulations (CFTC, EMIR) are adhered to accurately.
4. Assisting the agile team in database design and micro services workflow to perform individual functions.
5. Knowledge Transfer session to the subsequent Development and Test teams.
6. Writing down the BRDs and FRDs as and when required, constructing process flow diagrams, use case diagrams, architecture diagram at articulate scope/requirements.
7. Knowledge sharing sessions on Trade Life Cycle, MIFID II, EMIR, CFTC and different investment banking products to facilitate domain knowledge to technical teams.
Apr 2012 - May 2015 (Barclays Technology Center, India)
Role	: Senior Business Analyst Domain	: Wealth & Investment Banking Client	: Barclays Bank
Project Summary: STP – Fulfilment & Multi-Channel Application
The purpose of the project is to create a service which would integrate with different downstream systems via a middleware layer for client/account creation and maintenance. Multi-Channel Application (MCA) is a multi-purpose application which includes a single functionality for multiple channels like telephony, staff-facing, and customer-facing for Account Opening and Account maintenance purposes in Barclays.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Functional analysis and studying the business requirements of the project & document business requirements, process & data flows.
2. Modeling of current state/new state data & process models.
3. Supporting of application processes implementations.
4. Identify and manage business and data requirements change and implications across the lifecycle.
5. Manage traceability of requirements.
6. Additionally, contribute to functional impact analysis in the event of changes to business objectives, requirements and/or technical data/architectures/platforms.
7. Identify and specify as necessary current and future state business and data requirements, and associated data dependencies.
Apr 2006 – Feb 2012 (HSBC Software India Pvt. Ltd, Pune)
Role	: Module Lead Domain	: Retail Banking Client	: HTSE, UK
Project Summary: BMM, CNS and STP
Browser Main Menu (BMM) is a staff facing application which is used in the bank and call centre to provide account maintenance and support to UK customers. Customer Needs System (CNS) is an application which is used by the bank staff for Account Opening. Straight through Processing (STP) is an internet-based application which is used for account opening and maintenance.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Involved in test case preparation, data setup, peer review, test case execution, and defect retesting and client co-ordination.
2. Preparing the project estimates and verifying the same sent by the client.
3. Create a Test Activity Plan (TAP) and test design for the system test phase of the project.
4. Looking closely at Deliverables, Risks, Mitigations, Challenges and Value additions for projects.
5. Provide UAT support and create a Test Activity Completion Certificate.
6. Attend PIR meeting/process and provide comments on successes/improvements to process.
7. Performing requirements gathering workshops, creating BRD/FRD.
8. Conducting grooming sessions for the development team.
9. Providing sprint demo to business stakeholders and manage sprint backlog.

residual_blocks.quote: Professional Experience
July 2024 – Till date (Independent Practice, India)
Client	: Select Individual Investors
Project Summary:

Engaged in independent trading practice and portfolio management for a small group of investors. Focused on applying advanced trading strategies, risk management techniques, and disciplined portfolio optimization to deliver consistent performance and practical insights.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Completed structured training programs in advanced trading, risk management, and market structure analysis.
2. Managed investment portfolios for individual investors, emphasizing asset allocation, risk-adjusted returns, and performance tracking.
3. Applied option payoff modeling, delta-neutral positioning, and tactical portfolio adjustments to optimize outcomes.
4. Conducted market research and implemented disciplined trading frameworks to enhance decision-making and portfolio resilience.
5. Provided regular updates and performance reviews to investors, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Dec 2023 – July 2024 (Luxoft, India)
Project Summary:
The purpose of the project is the delivery of transaction reports for EMIR, MiFiD, DDFA, FinFrag, and MAS reporting.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Understanding business requirements for transaction reporting of multiple jurisdictions and translating the same into user stories.
2. Preparing, maintaining, and prioritizing product backlog.
3. Act as liaison between technology and the business to clarify functional issues during the project lifecycle and track them to closure.

4. Establish and maintain effective relationships with core and extended project team members, stakeholders, peers, and business representatives including Legal, compliance, technical teams, Finance, regulatory teams, etc.
5. Providing estimates for delivery.
6. Imparting domain & tool related trainings to new team members.
7. Providing E2E project management.
Domain	: Payments and Cash Management
Client	: Credit Agricole Corporate and Invesment Bank
Project Summary:

The purpose of the project is the delivery of SWIFT cross border payment processing, SEPA payments and billing engine. It requires in-depth understanding of cross border payment formats (Swift MT101, MT103, MT202, MT202COV, MT900/910, CAMT 052/053/054, etc) and SEPA payments (pain.001, pacs.008, pacs.009, etc). It also includes building the orchestration layer for liaising with the payment engine, virtual account management for account reconciliation, and host to host communication for direct integration with the banking downstream applications.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Coordinate with multiple stakeholders to understand business requirements.
2. Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, and provide optimized solutions proposal.
3. Maintain product backlog, and assign severity and priority to user stories based on business need.
4. Prepare BRD’s and FRD’s if required.
5. Document as-is and would-be state of project in the form of process flow diagram and activity diagram using Visio/Enterprise Architect tools.
6. Manage project risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies with other program streams to overcome challenges and propose mitigation plans.
7. Understand the proprietary XML format of GPP and mapping it to different downstream applications in the payment flow.
8. Assist the UAT team in the functional analysis of the reported issues.
May 2015 - Sept 2019 (Barclays Technology Center, India)
Role	: AVP - Lead Business Analyst
Domain	: Finance & Risk (Credit Risk, Market Risk and Liquidity Risk) Client	: Barclays Bank
Project Summary: Local Regulatory Reporting (Asia Pacific & UK)

The purpose of the project is the delivery of finance and risk regulatory reports, transaction reports to the local country specific regulators in Asia Pacific region. It also includes risk engine calculations for reporting related to Counterparty Credit risk, Market risk, Liquidity risk, Basel III implementation, IFRS 9 implementation, and exposure to methodologies like VaR, Expected shortfall, PE, EEPE, CVA, etc.
Roles and Responsibilities:
1. Understanding the new finance and risk regulatory requirements from the business and performing the impact analysis to the current architecture.

2. Requirements gathering and understanding the changes applicable to the various businesses for products like Equity, Fixed Income, FX, AML, Rates, Commodities, Structured credit products, Derivatives, loans & deposits, collateral management, profit & loss, etc.
3. Ensuring the regulatory transaction reporting regulations (CFTC, EMIR) are adhered to accurately.
4. Assisting the agile team in database design and micro services workflow to perform individual functions.
5. Knowledge Transfer session to the subsequent Development and Test teams.
6. Writing down the BRDs and FRDs as and when required, constructing process flow diagrams, use case diagrams, architecture diagram at articulate scope/requirements.
7. Knowledge sharing sessions on Trade Life Cycle, MIFID II, EMIR, CFTC and different investment banking products to facilitate domain knowledge to technical teams.
